changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.19

- Swap profiles now have a configurable "Pause Delay" (next to Delay in the profile editor): the wait between opening the inventory and pressing the loadouts key. Replaces the previous fixed 100ms so you can tune it per profile.
- Defaults to 100ms; each of your swap profiles keeps its own value.
- No changes to packet logic, keybinds, or the update process.
